$comment: remaining = cap − drawn − reserved. `reserved` is the money committed by payments we have signed but not yet seen resolve, and it INCLUDES payments in the `unknown` state — assuming those failed and freeing their budget is how one challenge gets paid twice (I4). S5 cannot be disabled, and the loser of the FIFO race receives this code.

cases.name: pass · comfortably inside the remaining budget
boundary · EXACTLY the remaining budget is allowed
boundary · one micro-USDC over the remaining budget is refused
fail · in-flight payments hold their budget
cases.$why: The cap has plenty drawn against it, but signed-and-unresolved payments have reserved the rest. This is the case a naive `cap − drawn` would get wrong.
